evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to properly handle and validate CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR installation paths.
rationale: Fixes CMake installation path handling for distributions that customize libexec paths. On systems like Arch Linux that set CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR to 'lib', installed wrapper builds currently cannot locate internal binaries and fail at runtime.
